channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: PM Modi lands in Thiruvananthapuram, thousands line the roads to see him
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi landed in the Kerala capital city on Friday to a rousing reception, marking a politically significant visit in the wake of the BJP’s historic victory in the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation.

item.title: MUDA scam: ED attaches illegally allotted properties worth Rs 20.85cr; total attachment touches Rs 460cr
item.description: The ED initiated the investigation on the basis of an FIR filed by the Lokayukta Police, Mysuru, in the case of a large-scale scam involving illegal allotment of sites by MUDA.

item.title: Sunny Deol says ‘no worries, no stress’ as ‘Border 2’ hits the screens
item.description: Actor Sunny Deol struck a relaxed and upbeat note as his much-awaited film ‘Border 2’ finally hit the screens on Friday.

item.title: Ahead of TN Visit, Modi Claims Growing Support for NDA
item.description: Ahead of his Tamil Nadu visit, Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday asserted the National Democratic Alliance’s (NDA) growing appeal in the southern state.

item.title: US expands Mexico City Policy on foreign aid
item.description: An administration official said the State Department will release three final rules expanding the policy’s reach. The changes extend the policy from global health programs to all nonmilitary foreign assistance.

item.title: CM Pinarayi Vijayan welcomes PM Modi, hails Centre’s clearance of key projects for Kerala
item.description: Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan on Friday extended a warm welcome to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who arrived in Thiruvananthapuram to inaugurate and launch a series of major development projects, describing the occasion as a “cherished moment of satisfaction” for Kerala.

item.title: KTR appears before SIT in phone-tapping case
item.description: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) working president K.T. Rama Rao on Friday appeared before the Special Investigation Team (SIT) probing the phone tapping case.

item.title: Krishna Shroff to Enter Reality Show ‘The 50’, Says She’s Ready to Shine
item.description: Veteran Bollywood star Jackie Shroff’s daughter Krishna, is all set to step into the upcoming reality show The 50 and said that as long as she holds on to her self-belief and stays open to the adventure, she knows she would shine in the unpredictable game.

item.title: J&K Crime Branch files charge sheet in Budgam land fraud case
item.description: The J&K Police's Crime Branch said on Friday that it has filed the charge sheet in the Budgam district land fraud case.

item.title: Injured New Zealand quick Adam Milne ruled out of T20 WC; Jamieson named replacement
item.description: Right-arm fast bowler Adam Milne has been ruled out of the ICC T20 World Cup with a torn left hamstring and will be replaced in the squad by Kyle Jamieson, New Zealand Cricket (NZC) said on Friday.
